name: Eula's Mother
description: Eula's mother, whose side of the family once worked for the Cabaretti; she helps Eula pack for Arcavios.

description_citations.work: An Excerpt from Strixhaven: Omens of Chaos, a Magic: The Gathering Novel
description_citations.text: "An Excerpt from Strixhaven: Omens of Chaos, a Magic: The Gathering Novel " by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Eula's father hands her a letter that has arrived for her, opened, by omenpath courier.
timeline.quote: "Eula," says her father, lowering the letter. "This came for you."

citation.work: An Excerpt from Strixhaven: Omens of Chaos, a Magic: The Gathering Novel
citation.text: "An Excerpt from Strixhaven: Omens of Chaos, a Magic: The Gathering Novel " by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Eula learns the letter is an invitation to Strixhaven on Arcavios with tuition and supplies covered and an omenpath ticket.
timeline.quote: "A place called Strixhaven, on a plane called Arcavios. They teach wizards there."

citation.work: An Excerpt from Strixhaven: Omens of Chaos, a Magic: The Gathering Novel
citation.text: "An Excerpt from Strixhaven: Omens of Chaos, a Magic: The Gathering Novel " by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Eula's mother tells her she leaves tomorrow and they begin to pack.
